## 2. Professional Summary & Philosophy
Alok Das combines analytical laboratory rigor with software craftsmanship. Rather than viewing chemistry and computer programming as distinct domains, he utilizes software development as a high-leverage tool to automate calculations, visualize complex molecular behaviors, simulate laboratory procedures, and organize experimental data.

His core scientific training is grounded in analytical chemistry, qualitative and quantitative analysis, phytochemical extraction of natural compounds, and chromatographic profiling. His technical skillset focuses on cross-platform mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and modern web architectures (Next.js, TypeScript).
